name: A Lesson in Divinity
summary: Danitha Morr sends you to Venomweb Vale to find Deathguard Falgan. He and his companion were separated after learning the Scarlet Crusade plans an attack on Brill.

sections.title: Falgan's Return
sections.body: Deathguard Falgan went with Billmuth to scout Scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. They learned the Scarlet Crusade plans some kind of attack. Now Falgan asks whether you will help the Forsaken further.

faq.q: Who is asking me to find Falgan?
faq.answer: Danitha Morr asks you to find Deathguard Falgan and help him if you can.
Falgan stayed behind after a noise alerted Scarlet forces to him and his companion. His companion reached Brill without him.

faq.q: What did Falgan and Billmuth discover?
faq.answer: Falgan and Billmuth learned that the Scarlet Crusade plans some kind of attack.

faq.q: What is the Symbol of Life for?
faq.answer: The Symbol of Life is used to bring Deathguard Falgan back to life.

faq.q: What does Falgan ask after returning?
faq.answer: After returning, Falgan asks whether you are willing to help the Forsaken further.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Lesson in Divinity
